test_policy.notes: Test-optional for 2027-28; applicants who submit a high school transcript receive full consideration for admission and scholarships. Some programs set their own requirements (e.g. SAT 1200+/ACT 25 to be considered for the accelerated 3+2 Physician Assistant interview, TEAS 65+ for Lock Haven ASN nursing, music audition). For international applicants an SAT of 980 (EBRW 500+) or ACT 20 can also satisfy English proficiency.

requirements.notes: Apply with the university's own online application (one application can name one, two or all three campuses). $35 non-refundable fee, paid by credit card at submission. International first-years send official English-translated secondary records and certificates (unofficial copies may be uploaded first); the university may ask for a credential evaluation (WES, IERF, ECE or The Evaluation Company). The pages checked do not state essay or recommendation requirements.

deadlines.label: International first-year application deadline, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: The international page gives 'Fall Semester: June 1st' with no year, so fall 2027 entry is assumed. Spring semester is Nov. 1. Domestic applicants: most programs are rolling with no closing date (Common Data Set).

deadlines.label: Priority deadline for selective programs (nursing, accelerated health science, medical imaging)
deadlines.notes: Nov. 15 priority consideration for Nursing (BSN at Bloomsburg and Mansfield, ASN at Lock Haven), accelerated 3+2 PA and 3+3 PT, Medical Imaging; Music (BS/BM) is Dec. 15. The year is not printed, so the 2027-28 cycle is assumed.

deadlines.label: International merit scholarship: complete application and pay deposit by May 1
deadlines.notes: Scholarship page: international students must complete their application and pay the deposit by May 1 of the senior year (year not printed, so 2027 is assumed). Funding is limited and first come, first served.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not required for applicants from: American Samoa, Australia, Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Canada (except Quebec), Dominica, Grenada, Grand Cayman, Ghana, Guyana, Ireland, Jamaica, Liberia, New Zealand, South Africa, Trinidad & Tobago, UK (England, N. Ireland, Scotland, Wales), U.S. Pacific Trust. Students with more than one semester of for-credit study at a U.S. institution may be exempt. Scores must come directly from the testing body. No conditional admission or ESL pathway program is described on the page.

english.notes: Internet-based 70; page also lists 197 computer-based, 525 paper-based and TOEFL Essentials 8-9.5.
Page lists '4 (new internet-based)' without naming the 1-6 scale.
Cambridge English score of 160 or higher (First B2, Advanced C1, Proficiency).

aid.notes: Scholarship page: GPA-based merit scholarships for international first-years who apply and pay the deposit by May 1; the page says award amounts will be finalized once the institutional aid budget is approved, so no amounts are given here. The Common Data Set instead marks need-based (not non-need-based) institutional aid for nonresidents, with 31 recipients averaging $10,413. International students are not eligible for federal aid.

majors.notes: Selective with Nov. 15 priority consideration; extra requirements apply (the page does not detail them for BSN).
